title: What Visual Representations Do World Action Models Need?

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) inherit powerful priors from pretrained video generation models, but their variational autoencoder (VAE) representations are optimized for visual reconstruction rather than manipulation. Recent studies show that external visual representations improve manipulation performance and robustness. However, these methods select representations based on presumed capability gaps and use different integration mechanisms, making it difficult to disentangle the effects of representation choice and integration. To better understand how external representations strengthen WAMs, we conduct a systematic study through controlled comparisons of multiple visual representations, five integration mechanisms, and feature combinations. Our study yields three main findings. First, strong general-purpose visual representations provide broader robustness gains and can match or outperform representations pretrained for specific visual capabilities. Second, channel-wise joint prediction achieves the highest average success rate; further analyses suggest that future-feature prediction and the action expert’s effective use of added visual information contribute to its gains. Third, additional sources should be selected for the task-relevant information they contribute beyond existing representations, as the same source can help one combination but harm another. However, even the best evaluated composition provides a smaller additional gain than the initial improvement from adding a strong general-purpose representation to the VAE-only baseline. We instantiate the resulting R epresentation R ecipe as R 2 -WAM. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop with an 84.7% success rate and reaches 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0, improving over the VAE-only baselines by 5.9 and 2.2 percentage points, respectively. Taken together, these findings suggest that future work should prioritize stronger general-purpose visual representations and more effective mechanisms for integrating them into WAMs, with feature composition serving as a supplementary route to improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）从预训练的视频生成模型中继承了强大的先验知识，但其变分自编码器（VAE）表示是针对视觉重建而非操控进行优化的。 近期研究表明，外部视觉表示能够提升操控性能与鲁棒性。 然而，这些方法基于假设的能力差距来选择表示，并采用不同的整合机制，这使得分离表示选择与整合效应变得困难。 为了更好地理解外部表示如何增强WAMs，我们通过受控比较多种视觉表示、五种整合机制及特征组合，开展了一项系统性研究。 我们的研究得出三个主要发现。 首先，强大的通用视觉表示能带来更广泛的鲁棒性提升，并且能够匹敌甚至超越为特定视觉能力预训练的表示。 其次，通道级联合预测实现了最高的平均成功率；进一步分析表明，未来特征预测以及动作专家对新增视觉信息的有效利用是其性能提升的关键因素。 第三，应选择能为任务提供现有表示之外额外信息的来源，因为同一来源可能有助于一种组合，却可能对另一种产生负面影响。 然而，即使评估表现最佳的组合方式，其带来的额外增益也小于将强大通用表示加入纯VAE基线模型时的初始提升幅度。 我们将由此得到的表示配方具体化为R2-WAM。 它在RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop数据集上实现了84.7%的成功率，达到了当前最优性能；在RoboTwin 2.0上则达到92.8%，分别比纯VAE基线模型提升了5.9和2.2个百分点。 综合来看，这些发现表明未来的研究应优先采用更强大的通用视觉表示，并探索更有效的机制将其整合到WAMs中，而特征组合则可作为提升性能的补充途径。

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generation models to robot control by jointly predicting future video and actions. This allows robot policies to draw on the visual structure and temporal dynamics learned through large-scale video pretraining, as demonstrated by DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026b ) , LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) , and Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Along with these priors, WAMs inherit the latent space of their variational autoencoders (VAEs).
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测未来视频和动作，将预训练的视频生成模型适配到机器人控制中。 这使得机器人策略能够利用通过大规模视频预训练所学到的视觉结构和时序动态，正如 DreamZero（Ye et al., 2026b）、LingBot-VA（Li et al., 2026a）和 Fast-WAM（Yuan et al., 2026）所展示的那样。 除了这些先验知识外，WAMs 还继承了其变分自编码器（VAEs）的潜在空间。

paragraphs.en: The inherited VAE is optimized for visual reconstruction ( Wan Team et al., 2025 ) , but how well its representations support robot manipulation remains unclear. Its reconstruction objective does not explicitly prioritize manipulation-relevant information, such as object semantics and spatial relationships. Recent studies augment WAMs with external visual features and report improvements in manipulation performance and robustness ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026b ; Ma et al., 2026a ) . However, these methods select different representations based on prior assumptions about which visual capabilities WAMs lack. Systematic comparisons across representation types remain limited, leaving unclear which visual representations best support robot manipulation in WAMs.
paragraphs.zh: 继承的 VAE 针对视觉重建进行了优化（Wan Team 等，2025），但其表示对机器人操作的支持效果如何仍不明确。 其重建目标并未明确优先考虑与操作相关的信息，例如物体语义和空间关系。 近期研究通过为 WAMs 添加外部视觉特征，报告了其在操作性能和鲁棒性方面的提升（Qiu 等，2026；Yan 等，2026b；Ma 等，2026a）。 然而，这些方法基于对 WAMs 缺乏哪些视觉能力的先验假设，选择了不同的表示方式。 不同表示类型之间的系统性比较仍然有限，因此尚不清楚哪种视觉表示最能支持 WAMs 的机器人操作。

paragraphs.en: Beyond representation choice, WAM performance also depends on the mechanism used to integrate external features into the model ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . A further question is whether combining more representations leads to continued performance gains. External features can be integrated through representation alignment ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) , action conditioning ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , or joint prediction ( Yan et al., 2026a ) . Existing studies often couple selected representations with specific integration designs ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , making the effects of representation choice and integration mechanism difficult to disentangle across methods. Besides, the diverse demands of manipulation—including semantics, geometry, object extent, motion, and interaction—suggest that different representations may be needed. Yet additional sources may also introduce redundant information or interference during optimization. Whether and when different feature combinations improve WAM performance therefore remains an empirical question.
paragraphs.zh: 除了表示选择之外，WAM 的性能还取决于将外部特征整合到模型中所用到的机制（Yang et al., 2026）。 另一个问题是，结合更多表示是否会导致性能持续提升。 外部特征可以通过表示对齐（Yu et al., 2025；Qiu et al., 2026）、动作条件化（Wang et al., 2026c）或联合预测（Yan et al., 2026a）进行整合。 现有研究通常将选定的表示与特定的整合设计耦合在一起（Qiu et al., 2026；Yan et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2026a），这使得不同方法中表示选择和整合机制的影响难以区分。 此外，操控任务的多样化需求——包括语义、几何、物体范围、运动和交互——表明可能需要不同的表示。 然而，额外的来源也可能在优化过程中引入冗余信息或干扰。 因此，不同特征组合是否以及何时能够提升 WAM 性能，仍然是一个需要实证研究的问题。

paragraphs.zh: 哪些视觉表示能够提升WAM的性能？

paragraphs.zh: 哪种特征注入机制能从外部特征中获得最大的性能提升？

paragraphs.en: Our controlled comparisons yield three findings that guide the selection, integration, and composition of external visual representations for WAMs. (1) General-purpose visual representations should be the default choice for augmenting WAMs. They can match or outperform representations pretrained for specific visual capabilities—even under perturbations relevant to those capabilities—while providing broader robustness gains. (2) Channel-wise joint prediction yields the largest average gains across matched sources. Our analyses suggest that future-feature prediction and effective use of the added visual information by the action expert contribute to these gains and should guide future integration designs. (3) Additional sources should be selected for the task-relevant information they add beyond the existing representations. The same source can improve one combination but provide little benefit or even reduce performance in another. Although feature composition can provide further gains, these are limited compared with the initial improvement. Feature composition should therefore serve as a supplementary route to improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的受控比较得出了三项发现，这些发现为 WAMs 的外部视觉表示的选择、集成和组合提供了指导。 (1) 通用型视觉表示应成为增强 WAMs 的默认选择。 它们能够匹配甚至超越针对特定视觉能力预训练的表示——即使在这些能力相关的扰动条件下也是如此——同时还能带来更广泛的鲁棒性提升。 (2) 按通道进行的联合预测在匹配的源数据中带来了最大的平均增益。 我们的分析表明，未来特征预测以及动作专家对新增视觉信息的有效利用促成了这些增益，并应指导未来的集成设计。 (3) 应选择能为任务提供现有表示之外额外信息的源数据。 同一源数据可能提升一种组合效果，但在另一种组合中却几乎无益，甚至可能降低性能。 尽管特征组合能带来进一步的增益，但与初始改进相比，这些增益较为有限。 因此，特征组合应被视为一种辅助性的改进途径。

paragraphs.en: WAMs learn action prediction alongside future visual dynamics. DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026b ) transfers a pretrained video diffusion backbone to joint video–action generation, and LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) combines autoregressive diffusion with closed-loop visual feedback. Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) shows that video co-training can benefit control even when future video generation is omitted at inference. Other studies modify the visual prediction space or its supervision. LDA-1B ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) learns dynamics in DINO feature space, while LaWAM ( Chen et al., 2026a ) conditions action generation on predicted latent visual subgoals. RepWAM ( Wang et al., 2026b ) and LingBot-VA 2.0 ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) learn semantically aligned visual–action tokenizers. ST-WAM ( Wang et al., 2026c ) diagnoses failures under visual shifts and combines DINO future prediction and history retrieval with VAE dynamics. Robust-WAM ( Yan et al., 2026b ) aligns queries in the action stream with future semantic features while retaining the VAE generation pathway. Flex- π \pi ( Yan et al., 2026a ) jointly denoises RGB latents, 3D pointmaps, DINO features, and actions, supporting different combinations of input and prediction streams at deployment. These studies demonstrate the effectiveness of specific visual representations within their respective WAM designs, but systematic comparisons are still needed to identify which features complement the capabilities that WAMs inherit from pretrained video generators.
paragraphs.zh: WAM 会在学习动作预测的同时，学习未来视觉动态。 DreamZero（Ye 等，2026b）将预训练的视频扩散模型主干迁移到联合视频-动作生成任务中，而 LingBot-VA（Li 等，2026a）则将自回归扩散模型与闭环视觉反馈相结合。 Fast-WAM（Yuan 等，2026）表明，即使在推理阶段省略未来视频生成，视频协同训练仍能为控制带来益处。 其他研究则对视觉预测空间或其监督机制进行了修改。 LDA-1B（Lyu 等，2026）在 DINO 特征空间中学习动态，而 LaWAM（Chen 等，2026a）则将动作生成条件于预测的潜在视觉子目标。 RepWAM（Wang 等，2026b）和 LingBot-VA 2.0（Zhang 等，2026b）学习了语义对齐的视觉-动作分词器。 ST-WAM（Wang 等，2026c）能够诊断视觉变化导致的失败情况，并将 DINO 未来预测与历史检索结合 VAE 动态模型进行使用。 Robust-WAM（Yan 等，2026b）在保留 VAE 生成路径的同时，将动作流中的查询与未来语义特征进行对齐。 Flex-π（Yan 等，2026a）联合对 RGB 潜在变量、3D 点云图、DINO 特征和动作进行去噪，支持部署时输入流与预测流的不同组合。 这些研究证明了特定视觉表示在其各自的 WAM 设计中的有效性，但仍需系统性比较，以明确哪些特征能够补充 WAM 从预训练视频生成模型中继承的能力。

paragraphs.en: Pretraining objectives shape the information captured by visual representations. Visual self-supervision has produced encoders such as DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , VC-1 ( Majumdar et al., 2023 ) , LingBot-Vision ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , VideoMAE V2 ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . Language-associated approaches include image–text models such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , as well as multimodal language models such as Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . Other pretraining objectives target segmentation with SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) , geometry with VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , and interaction-related information with HRP ( Srirama et al., 2024 ) and DynaFLIP ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . UniTok ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and C-RADIOv4 ( Ranzinger et al., 2026 ) further combine multiple learning objectives or teacher models within a single representation. These approaches provide different but overlapping visual capabilities, but how their pretraining emphases translate into manipulation gains in WAMs remains an empirical question.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练目标决定了视觉表示所捕捉的信息。 视觉自监督已催生出多种编码器，例如 DINOv3（Siméoni 等，2026）、VC-1（Majumdar 等，2023）、LingBot-Vision（Fu 等，2026）、VideoMAE V2（Wang 等，2023）以及 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia 等，2026）。 与语言相关的方法包括图像-文本模型，如 CLIP（Radford 等，2021）和 SigLIP 2（Tschannen 等，2025），以及多模态语言模型，如 Qwen3.5（Qwen Team，2026）。 其他预训练目标则聚焦于 SAM 3（Carion 等，2025）的分割任务、VGGT-Ω（Wang 等，2026a）的几何任务，以及 HRP（Srirama 等，2024）和 DynaFLIP（Lee 等，2026）中与交互相关的信息。 UniTok（Ma 等，2025）和 C-RADIOv4（Ranzinger 等，2026）进一步将多种学习目标或教师模型整合到单一表示中。 这些方法提供了不同但存在重叠的视觉能力，然而它们的预训练侧重点如何转化为 WAMs 中的操控能力提升，仍是一个需要实证研究的问题。

The model comprises a video expert initialized from Wan 2.2 ( Wan Team et al., 2025 ) and a separate action expert. paragraphs.en: We evaluate LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) with 50 rollouts per task following Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ; full results are reported in the Appendix D since performance is near saturation. We report per-category and overall success rates. RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) uses 50 trials per task across 24 tasks, while RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) uses 100 trials per task across 50 tasks in each of the clean and randomized settings. paragraphs.en: The VAE-only WAM achieves high success rates under language perturbations ( 91.1 % 91.1\% ) and lighting changes ( 94.3 % 94.3\% ), yet performs substantially worse under viewpoint changes ( 51.2 % 51.2\% ), background changes ( 62.0 % 62.0\% ), and image noise ( 66.6 % 66.6\% ). This uneven robustness motivates examining whether external visual representations can address these weaknesses and improve performance across perturbation categories.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用 VAE 的 WAM 在语言扰动（91.1%）和光照变化（94.3%）下实现了较高的成功率，但在视角变化（51.2%）、背景变化（62.0%）和图像噪声（66.6%）下的表现则明显更差。 这种不均衡的鲁棒性促使我们进一步研究：外部视觉表示能否解决这些弱点，并提升其在各类扰动下的整体性能。

paragraphs.en: Building on RQ1 and RQ2, we use DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) as the initial external representation and keep channel-wise concatenation fixed. The candidate additions span different pretraining emphases, with representatives from each category in Section 3.2 : V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) for visual self-supervision, SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) for language-associated learning, SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) for segmentation, VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) for geometry, HRP ( Srirama et al., 2024 ) for interaction-oriented pretraining, and UniTok ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and C-RADIOv4 ( Ranzinger et al., 2026 ) for multi-objective / multi-teacher learning. We first add each candidate separately to DINOv3, then evaluate selected larger combinations through single-source additions (Figure 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 RQ1 和 RQ2 的基础上，我们使用 DINOv3（Siméoni 等人，2026）作为初始的外部表示，并保持通道级拼接固定不变。 候选添加项涵盖了不同的预训练重点，其中每个类别的代表均见第 3.2 节：V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia 等人，2026）用于视觉自监督，SigLIP 2（Tschannen 等人，2025）用于语言相关学习，SAM 3（Carion 等人，2025）用于分割，VGGT-Ω（Wang 等人，2026a）用于几何学，HRP（Srirama 等人，2024）用于面向交互的预训练，以及 UniTok（Ma 等人，2025）和 C-RADIOv4（Ranzinger 等人，2026）用于多目标/多教师学习。 我们首先将每个候选项单独添加到 DINOv3 中，然后通过对单源添加项进行评估，来检验选定的更大组合（图 4）。

paragraphs.en: DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) alone improves LP success by 9.3 9.3 percentage points over VAE-only, while adding other features yields at most a further 3.7 3.7 -point gain among the evaluated combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用 DINOv3（Siméoni 等人，2026）即可将 LP 成功率在 VAE 单独使用的情况下提升 9.3 个百分点，而添加其他特征在已评估的组合中最多只能带来额外的 3.7 个百分点的提升。

paragraphs.en: The composition results suggest that overlap in pretraining objectives can limit complementary gains. Both UniTok ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) learn language-aligned visual representations. Adding SigLIP 2 improves DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) by 1.8 1.8 percentage points, but reduces success by 0.4 0.4 points once UniTok is included and adds only 0.2 0.2 points when V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) is also present. Spatial capabilities similarly overlap: DINOv3 already provides dense features supporting segmentation and depth estimation, while VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) uses a DINOv3-initialized visual encoder. Adding VGGT- Ω \Omega or SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) to DINOv3 produces little change, although both improve some larger combinations. A direct teacher–student relationship occurs with C-RADIOv4 ( Ranzinger et al., 2026 ) , which distills DINOv3, SigLIP 2, and SAM 3: combining it with DINOv3 reduces LP success to 78.6 % 78.6\% . Meanwhile, adding V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) to DINOv3 and UniTok improves performance, consistent with its video-based predictive pretraining providing complementary cues.
paragraphs.zh: 组合结果表明，预训练目标的重叠可能会限制互补性增益。 UniTok（Ma 等人，2025）和 SigLIP 2（Tschannen 等人，2025）都学习了与语言对齐的视觉表示。 添加 SigLIP 2 可将 DINOv3（Siméoni 等人，2026）的性能提升 1.8 个百分点，但在加入 UniTok 后，成功率会下降 0.4 个百分点；而当同时包含 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia 等人，2026）时，仅提升 0.2 个百分点。 空间能力也存在类似的重叠：DINOv3 已经提供了支持分割和深度估计的密集特征，而 VGGT-Ω（Wang 等人，2026a）则使用了以 DINOv3 初始化的视觉编码器。 将 VGGT-Ω 或 SAM 3（Carion 等人，2025）添加到 DINOv3 中几乎不会带来变化，尽管两者都能在某些更大的组合中提升性能。 C-RADIOv4（Ranzinger 等人，2026）与 DINOv3、SigLIP 2 和 SAM 3 之间存在直接的师生关系，它对这些模型进行了知识蒸馏；将其与 DINOv3 结合后，LP 成功率降至 78.6%。 与此同时，将 V-JEPA 2.1（Mur-Labadia 等人，2026）添加到 DINOv3 和 UniTok 中能够提升性能，这与它基于视频的预测性预训练所提供的互补线索一致。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we systematically study how the selection, integration, and composition of external visual representations affect VAE-based WAMs. Our findings suggest a practical recipe: start with a strong general-purpose representation, integrate it through channel-wise concatenation, and retain additional sources when they improve task success rates in the intended combination. R 2 -WAM instantiates this recipe and demonstrates gains across the evaluated robot embodiments and environments.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们系统地研究了外部视觉表示的选择、集成和组合如何影响基于 VAE 的 WAM。 我们的研究结果提出了一种实用的方法：首先使用一种强大的通用表示，通过通道级拼接将其集成，并在预期组合中当额外来源能提升任务成功率时保留这些来源。 R²-WAM 实现了这一方法，并在所评估的机器人实体和环境中都展示了性能提升。

paragraphs.en: Our findings provide a starting point for further research on visual representations and their use in WAMs. Future work should focus on training stronger general-purpose visual representations and developing integration mechanisms that improve future-feature prediction and enable action experts to use visual information more effectively.

paragraphs.en: Token-wise concatenation. Dense external features are flattened into a separate token sequence, mapped from C f C_{f} to the video-expert hidden width by an independent input projection, and appended to the VAE tokens. Feature and VAE tokens share all video-expert Transformer blocks, while a separate prediction head maps feature hidden states back to the source dimension C f C_{f} . Features are flattened in temporal, row, and column order into observed tokens F 0 F_{0} and future tokens F 1 : T F_{1:T} . LayerNorm precedes both the input projection and the prediction head; their linear projections use Xavier-uniform weights and zero biases. The combined token ordering is [ V 0 , V 1 : T , F 0 , F 1 : T , A ] [V_{0},V_{1:T},F_{0},F_{1:T},A] .

paragraphs.en: During training, F 0 F_{0} remains clean and F 1 : T F_{1:T} receives Gaussian noise sampled independently from the video noise. The scheduler-weighted MSE is evaluated over valid future feature tokens only. At inference, F 0 F_{0} is extracted from the observed views and kept clean, while F 1 : T F_{1:T} is initialized from Gaussian noise and jointly denoised with video and actions. The observed prefix F 0 F_{0} is restored after every solver step, and the final predicted feature trajectory is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练过程中，F₀保持干净，而F₁:T则接收从视频噪声中独立采样的高斯噪声。 特征流和视频流使用相同的采样时间步和相同的调度器，其中特征速度目标为ϵf−f₁:T，而ϵf是采样得到的特征噪声。 调度器加权的均方误差仅针对有效的未来特征令牌进行评估。 在推理阶段，F₀从观测到的视图中提取并保持干净，而F₁:T则从高斯噪声初始化，并与视频及动作共同去噪。 在每个求解器步骤之后，都会恢复观测到的前缀F₀，并且最终预测的特征轨迹会被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: At every layer, the video, feature, and action experts independently form their Q/K/V tensors. The tensors are concatenated for masked joint attention, then split by modality before each expert applies its own attention output projection, text cross-attention, normalization layers, and FFN. Joint attention does not imply parameter sharing: the feature expert owns independent Transformer parameters. Its attention mask follows the same routing as token-wise concatenation: action queries attend to observed and noisy future video/feature tokens and action tokens, while video and feature queries cannot attend to action tokens. Feature noise is independent of video noise, while the feature and video flows share the same timestep and scheduler. The observed feature prefix remains clean, and only valid future features enter the flow-matching loss. During inference, future features are initialized from noise and participate in joint denoising; the observed prefix is restored after every step, and the predicted feature trajectory is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 在每一层，视频、特征和行动专家都会独立地构建各自的 Q/K/V 张量。 这些张量会被拼接起来以进行掩码联合注意力计算，随后按模态拆分，之后每个专家会分别应用自身的注意力输出投影、文本交叉注意力、归一化层和前馈网络（FFN）。 联合注意力并不意味着参数共享：特征专家拥有独立的 Transformer 参数。 其注意力掩码遵循与逐词拼接相同的路由规则：行动查询可以关注已观察到的以及带有噪声的未来视频/特征令牌和行动令牌，而视频和特征查询则无法关注行动令牌。 特征噪声与视频噪声相互独立，但特征流和视频流共享相同的时间步和调度器。 已观察到的特征前缀保持纯净，只有有效的未来特征才会进入流匹配损失计算。 在推理阶段，未来特征会从噪声中初始化并参与联合去噪；已观察到的前缀会在每一步后恢复，而预测的特征轨迹则会被丢弃。
